kid:ks1:main.title: How it works
kid:ks1:main.tagline: Watch and listen. It is short!

tutor:std:home-tour.title: Your areas
tutor:std:home-tour.say: Across the top are your areas: Lessons, Students, Progress, Quizzes, Homework and Messages. Home is where you start.

tutor:std:home-attention.title: Needs your attention
tutor:std:home-attention.say: Needs your attention lists what to do next: homework to mark, written answers, and overdue work. Start at the top.

tutor:std:home-help.title: Help is always here
tutor:std:home-help.say: Your next lesson sits here. And How it works is on every page whenever you need a reminder.

cam.on: How it works is on every page

rings.on: How it works is on every page

cursor.on: How it works is on every page

tutor:std:fam-ways.title: Three ways in
tutor:std:fam-ways.say: A family can join you three ways: they book with you, you send an invite link, or they find your public page.

nodes.title: They book with you
nodes.sub: Their child appears in Enrol a student

nodes.title: Your public page
nodes.sub: They sign up, then you enrol them

tutor:std:fam-book.title: They booked with you
tutor:std:fam-book.say: When a parent books, their child appears in Enrol a student. Press Enrol, pick their subjects and year, then Enrol student.

tutor:std:fam-invite.title: Send an invite link
tutor:std:fam-invite.say: No booking? Type who it's for and press Create invite link. Send it to the parent. It works once, for 30 days.

callouts.text: Nothing is emailed for you: you send it

tutor:std:fam-page.title: Share your public page
tutor:std:fam-page.say: Or copy your page link and send it. Once the parent signs up, their children appear here, ready to enrol.

tutor:std:std-cards.title: Every child has a card
tutor:std:std-cards.say: Each enrolled child gets a card showing their year, subjects and a progress ring.

tutor:std:std-groups.title: Make a group
tutor:std:std-groups.say: Put children in a group. Then you can set homework, a quiz or a lesson for the whole group in one click.

tutor:std:std-support.title: Support settings
tutor:std:std-support.say: Open Edit details to switch off quiz timers, turn on calm mode, add extra time, enlarge text or read answers aloud.

tutor:std:std-owner.title: Only you can change them
tutor:std:std-owner.say: Families can't change these settings. Use the three dots on a card to pause or un-enrol a child.

tutor:std:les-library.title: Your lesson library
tutor:std:les-library.say: Lessons holds thousands of ready-made lessons, laid out on a curriculum map. Pick a subject and a year.
keys: Thousands of ready-made lessons::thousands of ready-made

cam.on: laid out on a curriculum map

tutor:std:les-find.title: Find a lesson
tutor:std:les-find.say: Each topic shows how many lessons it has. Or type in Search to jump straight to one.

tutor:std:les-preview.title: Preview it
tutor:std:les-preview.say: Open a lesson to see its plan. Press Preview lesson to click through exactly what a child will see.

tutor:std:les-build.title: Build your own
tutor:std:les-build.say: Press Create new lesson. Add slides, key words, multiple choice, sorting or matching, then Save. It joins your library.
keys: Add slides, key words::Add slides, key words

tutor:std:live-modes.title: Three ways to teach
tutor:std:live-modes.say: Teach on a video call, share to each child's device, or teach in person. You choose each time.

nodes.title: Video call
nodes.sub: Join the call inside the Hub

nodes.title: Share with children
nodes.sub: Each child follows on their own device

tutor:std:live-join.title: Start a video lesson
tutor:std:live-join.say: Schedule it for the children you pick. At lesson time, check your camera and mic, then press Join. No other app needed.

tutor:std:live-incall.title: Inside the call
tutor:std:live-incall.say: Beside the video are your tabs: Lessons, Quiz, Homework, Flashcards and a whiteboard. Press Teach and every screen follows yours.

tutor:std:live-share.title: Share with children
tutor:std:live-share.say: No video? Press Share with children. Each child follows on their own device and answers for themselves.

tutor:std:live-person.title: Teach in person
tutor:std:live-person.say: In the room? Tick who's there and tap in each child's answers. Parents see the results afterwards.
keys: Tap in each child's answers::tap in each

tutor:std:tools-try.title: Try the tools
tutor:std:tools-try.say: Tools, inside Lessons, has rulers, protractors, number lines and science diagrams. Open any tool to try it.
keys: Number lines and science diagrams::number lines and science

tutor:std:tools-give.title: Give a tool to children
tutor:std:tools-give.say: In Preview lesson, open Tools for this lesson. Press Add tool to this question, or Use it on all questions.

shots.on: or Use it on all questions

cam.on: or Use it on all questions

rings.off: or Use it on all questions

rings.on: or Use it on all questions

cursor.on: or Use it on all questions

tutor:std:quiz-make.title: Make a quiz
tutor:std:quiz-make.say: In Quizzes, press New quiz, pick topics from your question bank, and choose the subject and pass mark.
keys: Topics from your question bank::your question bank

tutor:std:quiz-marked.title: Marked for you
tutor:std:quiz-marked.say: Quizzes are marked instantly. Written answers go to Marking, in your one queue.
keys: Marking, your one queue::marking, in your one queue

tutor:std:quiz-starting.title: Starting quiz
tutor:std:quiz-starting.say: New students sit a starting quiz once. There's no pass mark, so you see where each child begins.
keys: No pass mark::There's no pass mark

tutor:std:quiz-flash.title: Flashcards
tutor:std:quiz-flash.say: Flashcards bring back the cards a child finds tricky. In a live lesson, you can present a deck on screen.

tutor:std:prog-class.title: Your whole class
tutor:std:prog-class.say: Each row is a child. Each subject shows a coloured score. Filter by year or group, or search for a name.

tutor:std:prog-child.title: One child
tutor:std:prog-child.say: Click a child to see each topic, how it's trending and their latest results. It updates from their marked work.

tutor:std:prog-levels.title: Your levels
tutor:std:prog-levels.say: Press Edit levels to rename levels or change where they start. Scores re-band instantly and no marks change.

parent:std:getting-in.title: How your child gets in
parent:std:getting-in.say: Your child appears in the Learning Hub once your tutor has enrolled them. That happens when you book with your tutor, and they add your child. Or, your tutor can send you a private link, and you add your child yourself. Your tutor decides which subjects your child can see.
keys: Book with your tutor::book with your tutor
Your tutor picks the subjects::which subjects

nodes.title: Learning Hub opens
nodes.sub: With the subjects your tutor chose

parent:std:invite.title: If your tutor sent you a link
parent:std:invite.say: If your tutor sends you a private link, open it while you're signed in to your parent account. Or sign up first. You'll see which tutor invited you. Choose which of your children to enrol, and they join straight away. The link works for one family, and lasts thirty days.
keys: Signed in as a parent::signed in
Choose which children::choose which of your children

parent:std:home.title: Home: the one-line verdict
parent:std:home.say: Home starts with one line, the verdict. It says On track, All done this week, or how many homework tasks are overdue. Tap it to go straight to where you can help. Underneath, you see this week's quizzes done, homework handed in, and what's waiting to be marked. More than one child? Switch between them at the top.

parent:std:lessons.title: Lessons
parent:std:lessons.say: Lessons shows what your tutor has shared. Open one and your child steps through it one idea at a time, with a quiz at the end.
keys: A quiz at the end::quiz at the end

parent:std:live.title: Live lessons
parent:std:live.say: When your tutor has a live lesson coming up, it shows in Live lessons. When it opens, you check the camera and microphone first, then press Join. If your tutor shares a lesson to your child's own device, a banner appears so they can join it.
keys: Camera and microphone check::camera and microphone

parent:std:progress.title: How they're doing
parent:std:progress.say: The Progress tab shows how your child is doing. You see their level, on your tutor's own scale, and what it takes to reach the next one. Tap Where does this level come from, for a plain explanation. And My curriculum journey shows how far through each subject they are.
keys: How your child is doing::how your child is doing
Their level, in plain words::their level
Where does this level come from

parent:std:report.title: A printable progress report
parent:std:report.say: Need something for a meeting, or the fridge? Press Progress report. You get a clean one-page summary for one child, with their subjects and next steps. Print it, or save it as a PDF from your browser's print window.
keys: Print, or save as PDF::Print it

parent:std:ask.title: Ask your tutor
parent:std:ask.say: Got a question? Use Ask your tutor on Home, or the Messages tab. Your tutor's reply comes back to you there. And you can always press How it works, at the top, to watch this again.
keys: How it works, any time::How it works

cam.on: How it works, at the top

rings.off: How it works, at the top

rings.on: How it works, at the top

parent:std:hand-over.title: Hand over to your child
parent:std:hand-over.say: When your child is ready to learn, press Hand over to them. The screen becomes their own simple space, with just their lessons, quizzes and homework. To come back to your portal, a grown-up answers a quick sum. To see exactly what your child sees, choose What your child sees, at the top of this window.
keys: A quick sum to return::quick sum

kid:std:hello.title: Hello!
kid:std:hello.say: Hello! This is your very own learning space. It shows you what to do next, and it helps you learn. Let's take a quick look.

kid:std:home.title: Your Home
kid:std:home.say: This is your Home. It shows one big thing to do next. Tap Go to start it. Tap the little speaker, and it reads it out loud to you.

callouts.text: Tap to hear it read out

kid:std:lessons.title: Lessons
kid:std:lessons.say: Lessons help you learn something new. You go through one idea at a time. There are questions to try, and a quiz at the end.
keys: A quiz at the end::quiz at the end

kid:std:homework.title: Homework
kid:std:homework.say: Your homework is here. Open it, do your best, and hand it in. Your tutor will look at it and tell you how you did.

kid:std:quizzes.title: Quizzes
kid:std:quizzes.say: Quizzes are short sets of questions. Read each one, and pick your answer. Not quite right? That's okay. You can have another go.
keys: Not quite right? That's okay::That's okay

kid:std:tools.title: Helper tools
kid:std:tools.say: Some questions have a helper tool, like a ruler or a protractor. Tap the tool button, and it opens right there to help you work out the answer. And tap the speaker to hear the question read out.

kid:std:cards.title: Flashcards
kid:std:cards.say: Flashcards help you remember things. Tap a card to flip it. Then say how well you knew it. The cards you find tricky come back again soon.
keys: Tap a card to flip it::Tap a card
Tricky ones come back::come back again

callouts.text: Tap the card to flip it
How well did you know it?

kid:std:grown-up.title: When you have finished
kid:std:grown-up.say: When you have finished, ask a grown-up to help you leave. They answer a little sum, and then you are all done. You can tap How it works any time to watch this again.

tutor:std:hw-set.title: Set homework
tutor:std:hw-set.say: In Homework, press Set homework. Choose a group, or tick individual children.

tutor:std:hw-add-details.title: Add the details
tutor:std:hw-add-details.say: Add a title, then write the instructions: what to do and what to hand in. Then pick the due date.

tutor:std:hw-worksheet.title: Attach a worksheet
tutor:std:hw-worksheet.say: Tick worksheets from your library. Interactive ones mark themselves. PDFs are answered in writing or with a photo.
keys: PDFs: writing or a photo::writing or with a photo

tutor:std:hw-assign.title: Send it
tutor:std:hw-assign.say: Press Assign homework. Each child gets their own copy, and families are told straight away.
keys: Families told straight away::told straight away

tutor:std:hw-tasks.title: Track it
tutor:std:hw-tasks.say: Each homework card shows who's still working, who's handed in and who's marked.

tutor:std:hw-handin.title: How children hand in
tutor:std:hw-handin.say: Children do the worksheet on screen, or type, add a photo or PDF, then press Hand in homework.
keys: Or type, add a photo::or type, add a photo

tutor:std:hw-mark.title: Mark it
tutor:std:hw-mark.say: Everything to mark is in To mark, oldest first. Add a score and feedback, then press Mark and next.

cam.on: Everything to mark is in To mark

rings.on: Everything to mark is in To mark

tutor:std:hw-results.title: Everyone sees it
tutor:std:hw-results.say: The child sees their score and your feedback. Their family sees it in the Learning Hub too.
keys: Score and your feedback::score and your feedback

tutor:std:msg-all.title: All in one place
tutor:std:msg-all.say: Messages keeps every conversation with families in one place, grouped by child.

tutor:std:msg-reply.title: Reply
tutor:std:msg-reply.say: Open a conversation, type your reply and press Send. The parent gets a notification.

tutor:std:msg-auto.title: Updates are automatic
tutor:std:msg-auto.say: You don't need to message about homework or marks. Families are told automatically.
keys: No need to message::You don't need to message

parent:std:hw-list.title: What's been set
parent:std:hw-list.say: The Homework tab lists everything your child's tutor has set. Each piece shows when it's due, and whether it's been handed in or marked. If something is overdue, you'll see it here, and on the Home verdict. New homework appears here as soon as it's set.

parent:std:hw-open.title: Open a piece of homework
parent:std:hw-open.say: Open one to see the instructions, and any worksheet or lesson to do first. Your child can type an answer, or add a photo or a PDF, then press Hand in homework. They can change it until the tutor marks it.
keys: Type, or add a photo::type an answer
Change it until marked::until the tutor marks it

parent:std:hw-marks.title: Marks and feedback
parent:std:hw-marks.say: When the tutor has marked it, the score and their feedback appear under the homework, and you're told. Your child's progress picks it up too, so you can see how they're getting on.

kid:std:hw-find.title: Find your homework
kid:std:hw-find.say: Tap Homework to see what your tutor has set. Tap one to open it. It tells you what to do, and when it is due.

kid:std:hw-do.title: Do it and hand it in
kid:std:hw-do.say: Read what to do. Then do the worksheet, on the screen or on paper, and write your answer. When you are done, hand it in. You can change it until your tutor has looked at it.

kid:std:hw-back.title: See how you did
kid:std:hw-back.say: When your tutor has marked it, you will see your score and a message from them. Well done for trying!

kid:ks1:hello.title: Hello!
kid:ks1:hello.say: Hello! This is your space. Let's see how it works.

kid:ks1:today.title: Today
kid:ks1:today.say: This is Today. It shows one thing to do. Tap the big Go button. Tap the speaker to hear it.

kid:ks1:play.title: Play and learn
kid:ks1:play.say: Tap Play and learn. Here are your quizzes. Tap one. Have a go!

kid:ks1:stars.title: Stars
kid:ks1:stars.say: Tap Stars. Do a quiz, and your stars shine here. Well done!
keys: Your stars shine here::stars shine here

kid:ks1:grown-up.title: All done
kid:ks1:grown-up.say: All done? Ask a grown-up to help you. Bye for now!
